exists.title: Exists
exists.description: Whether a generated key pair is present in the user's folder.

private_key_path.title: Private Key Path
private_key_path.description: Where a generated key lives, whether or not it exists yet.

public_key.title: Public Key
public_key.description: Contents of the public key, for pasting into a git host. Empty when no key has been generated.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the public key: bit length, SHA256 hash, comment and algorithm, in the form git hosts show a registered key in.

key_type.title: Key Type
key_type.description: Algorithm of the existing key, read from the public key itself (e.g. `ssh-ed25519`).

configured_path.title: Configured Path
configured_path.description: The path the user's profile currently authenticates with, which may point somewhere other than the generated key.

is_configured.title: Is Configured
is_configured.description: Whether the profile's SSH private key path is the generated key.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: A non-fatal problem with the key on disk, such as file permissions that could not be tightened.

403.description: Reading another user's key requires the Manage users permission.
